# Attadaṇḍa Sutta (Snp 4.15 (PTS Snp 182))

**ID:** Snp 4.15 (PTS Snp 182)
**Section:** Suttanipāta (snp)
**Collection:** Sutta
**Title (Pali):** Attadaṇḍa Sutta
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0505m.mul3.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

A full Chinese parallel is preserved in the *Yizu jing* (T 198) [Anālayo 2017].

**Parallels and text reuse**

- Passage-level parallels: T 198 佛說義足經; dhp367; G-Dhp 51–90 Bhikhuvagga; T 210.34 沙門品法句經第三十四三十有二章; T 212.33 ◎沙門品第三十三; T 213.32 法集要頌經苾芻品第三十二; UV 32 Bhikṣuvarga; Uv Kg 32 The Brixu; UVS 32 Bhikṣuvarga
- Mentioned in: Mnd 15 Attadaṇḍasuttaniddesa

**Sources**

- [Anderson and Smith 1913] Dines Andersen and Helmer Smith, Sutta-Nipāta (PTS, 1913) — Pali text and verse numbering (v. 935) of the Attadaṇḍasutta
- [Anālayo 2017] Bhikkhu Anālayo, A Meditator’s Life of the Buddha (2017) — Discussion of the bodhisattva's saṁvega and the Chinese parallel (T 198)
- [Fausböll 1891] V. Fausböll, The Jātaka Together with Its Commentary, Vol. 5 (1891) — Narrative setting linking the recitation of the Attadaṇḍasutta to the Rohiṇī river conflict
- [Goyal 2003] S. R. Goyal, Indian Buddhism after the Buddha (2003) — Discussion of Dharmanand Kosambi and the Rohiṇī dispute context in the Kuṇāla Jātaka
- [Kwee 2015] G. T. Maurits Kwee, Buddha as Therapist: Meditations (2015) — Account of the Shakya-Koliya dispute reconciled by the Attadaṇḍa Sutta
- [Norman 1997–2001] K. R. Norman, The Group of Discourses (Sutta Nipāta) (PTS, 1997/2001) — Uddāna title Attadaṇḍavara, and philological analysis of the term attadaṇḍa in Nidd I and Pj II
- [Nyanaponika 1978] Nyanaponika Thera, The Roots of Good and Evil (1978) — English title 'The Use of Violence' and translation of opening verses
- [Segall 2003] Seth Robert Segall (ed.), Encountering Buddhism: Western Psychology and Buddhist Teachings (2003) — Placement of the Attadaṇḍa Sutta in the Aṭṭhakavagga of the Suttanipāta
- [Sujin Boriharnwanaket] Sujin Boriharnwanaket, Perfections Leading to Enlightenment — Citation of the Mahāniddesa commentary on the Attadaṇḍa Sutta
